messages:
Maya (PM): ACME wants a single contract line: Dedicated + Priority lane, plus a temporary lift on surge softcaps for launch (90 days). Need quick triage: cost, infra effort, legal constraints.

Elena (Sales): context: pilot for a new feature. customer asks not to be throttled during spikes for first 3 months, and wants daily usage reporting.

Jon (Eng): doable via routing flag + dedicated pool. work: entitlement check, per-contract burst allowance, telemetry. estimate: small infra changes, ~2 sprints to productionize alerts and throttle playbook.

Priya (Finance): removing softcap raises expected unit cost. give me a model for 1.5x vs 2x headroom so we can quote. we should also consider a daily hard token ceiling to limit exposure.

Sam (Legal): safe to allow timeboxed exemption but require rollback clause. draft stub: "Pilot Exemption: For 90 days, Customer may exceed Surge Softcap up to an agreed allowance (e.g., 1.5x). Redwood may revoke exemption with 7 days' notice upon infrastructure stress, security events, or abuse. Sustained excess usage billed at Overage Rates."

Elena (Sales): customer prefers 1.5x and wants a hard daily cap. can we do both?

Jon (Eng): yes. implement multiplier + token ceiling in billing metadata. add alerting when allowance exceeded for 3 consecutive 5m windows, and auto-throttle fallback.

Priya (Finance): I'll run cost delta scenarios (baseline / 1.5x / 2x) and a daily cap scenario by EOD Fri. results will feed the quote.

BillingBot: Will provision a daily "acme-pilot-usage" report into their contract folder starting tomorrow.

Maya (PM): proposed launch gates: 1) routing flag + billing metadata in staging, 2) daily telemetry to customer, 3) finance cost signoff, 4) legal-signed clause, 5) runbook for throttle + notif. all green => flip exemption.

Sam (Legal): I'll circulate a tightened clause with rollback/notice and liability carveouts tomorrow.

Jon (Eng): I'll PR the routing flag and a runbook checklist by Thu.

Elena (Sales): I'll sync expectations with the customer and confirm they accept 7d revoke.

Maya (PM): Go/no-go call Tue 10am. keeping thread as single source for pilot scope. :thumbsup:
